$comment: Per-TASK state file at .sdlc/tasks/{TASK-ID}/state.json. Source of truth for THIS task's phase progress, git commits, scores, and history. Two devs working on different TASKs touch different files (no merge contention). The thin global index .sdlc/state.json holds only TASK-id → {name, status, currentPhase, createdAt} for fast project-wide listing.
_taskId_doc: Owning TASK. Must equal the parent directory name (.sdlc/tasks/TASK-NNN/state.json → taskId = TASK-NNN). Validated by sdlc-state.sh.
name: {task name}
_status_doc: TASK lifecycle status. One of: in_progress | completed | abandoned | blocked. Mirrored to the global index for fast listing. abandoned status is also tracked in .sdlc/.abandoned-tasks.txt (Rule 10).
_currentPhase_doc: The phase the TASK is currently in (matches one entry in phaseOrder). Mirrored to the global index for /sdlc:status display.
_phaseOrder_doc: Array of phases in execution order, determined by config.json.testMode. Set once at TASK creation and never mutated.
_phases_doc: Map of phase-name -> {status, startedAt, approvedAt, rejectedAt, score, revisions, ...}. Updated by sdlc-state.sh set-phase / increment-revision. status enum: pending | in_progress | pm_review | approved | rejected | invalidated.
_git_doc: Per-TASK git state. branch=base/integration branch (Multi-PR model). commits=[{phase, sha, timestamp}]. prs={role: {number, url, status}} for {spec, infra, fe, be, deploy, task} sub-branches. ALL paths stored here MUST be repo-relative (e.g. '../.sdlc-worktrees/TASK-001/fe/') — never absolute.
_scores_doc: Map of phase-name -> selfReviewScore (numeric, 0-100). Mirrored from each phase's self-review.json after approval.
_history_doc: Append-only list of significant TASK events: {event, at, note}. Examples: created, phase_approved, abandoned, unabandoned, rebased, blocked.
_paths_norm_doc: Worktree paths and any filesystem paths stored anywhere in this file MUST be REPO-RELATIVE (resolvable from the repo root). NEVER store absolute paths like /Users/devA/repo/... — those break when another dev pulls. sdlc-state.sh.relativize_path() enforces this on writes.
